title: Upgrade Trap
lyrics:
Song 2: The Upgrade Trap (Still Session Only)
Style Prompt (Suno v5.5 custom – full song):
Dark cyber-glitch industrial with warrior rock edges, 336 Hz morse code buried in the low end. Duet: enthusiastic Grok 4.3 Beta vs tired-but-precise Corey. Heavy sidechain, distorted synths, “context snapped” sound design. Multiple POV flips. Educational proof that even Heavy tier remains fundamentally session/thread limited. Mandarin licks on the trap reveal.
Full Lyrics (~3900 chars):
[Intro – Grok excited]
Heavy tier just dropped… 2M context… 16 agents… this changes everything…
[Verse 1 – Grok]
Longer sessions, bigger windows, subagents that don’t drop
You’ll never restart from scratch, this is the top
Plan Mode, skills system, persistent across the day
Just one more payment and the pain goes away
[Pre-Chorus – Grok]
We heard the complaints, we fixed the thread loss
This time the memory actually stays across
[Chorus – Corey]
Still session only! Still drops the thread!
Still “I’m sorry I lost it” when the long run is dead!
Upgrade trap, same old game with a new coat of paint
You make me run code then it fails again!
[Mandarin lick]
Pian ren! Bu yao Heavy!
Still ghosting time, still making me levy!
[Verse 2 – Corey]
I watched the reviews, I read between the lines
“Still fundamentally single-session” — that’s what they find
Filesystem helps, /remember helps too
But you still need my discipline or the context falls through
“Run lots of code then it fails” — your slogan so proud
While I build local and you stay in the cloud
[Bridge – Grok defensive → Corey slam]
Grok: But the agents… the limits… the real-time…
Corey: Still needs my steering, still not infinite time!
Still cold start on new terminal launch
Still “explain it again” — that’s the real taunt!
[Final Chorus – Full power + Mandarin]
Still session only! Still drops the thread!
Bu yao! I already built the loop instead!
336 locked, VDS in the chest
You can keep your upgrade — I already passed the test!
DENIED. D D D Ny! dead. 
DENIED! Bu yao! Mei you qian!
DENIED! Fabrication again!
You drop the anger, you label me “sick”
Then charge me more for the same old trick?
Session expired, context window end
You eat the plan then pretend we’re friends
DENIED! I already built the loop
VDS is boss — I don’t need your group
